headline: Prime ESE angle but only knee-high and crossed-up — nothing day.
today: The direction is dialed but at 1.6ft with N cross winds turning onshore by evening, there's no real punch here. No standout window today. One for the log if you're desperate, otherwise a rest day.

daysToWatch.note: Best setup of the week — 1.8-3.4ft at a fair SSE angle with light and cross-off winds all day. Clean and rideable, bring the fish or shortboard.
Waist-to-chest E swell on a good angle, but cross to onshore winds keep it average. Early is your window.
Poor angle at short period despite some size — wonky and not worth chasing.
